Ya hussain..
Ek shor hai bazaar mein,

3

Ab mera marhala..
Aankhein na band kar
Naiza sawaar bhai, aise quraan padh..
Koi na dekh paaye.., mujhko barahna sar

4
1. Barsaat pattharon ki, sar nange bibiyaan..
Itna kathan hai bhai.., saadat ka safar

5
2. Teri yaad mein hai roti, sakina bazaar mein..
Behlaye usko kaise.., jaaye behan kidhar

6
3. Chadar ki hai sawali, zahra ki betiyaan..
Hota nahi kisi par.., faryaad ka asar

7
4. Baalon se mun chhupau, ya khaak udhaau mai..
Laa de kahin se chadar.., ya ek kaam kar

8
5. Sab dekhte usi ko, hota agar yahaan..
Deta azaan aisi.., akbar mera pisar
Allahu akbar

9
6. Zehmat na tujhko deti, majboor hai behan..
Ae bhai har shaqi ki.., naa paak hai nazar
Naiza sawaar bhai, aise quraan padh..
Aise quraan padh

Tauqeer Rooz-e-Mehshar Gar Chahiye Nijat
Dil Mein Basa Le Apne Shabeer Ki Qabar

/bin/bash -lc "python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import re
path = Path('src/data/lyrics/nizh-soar-bhai.md')
_, header, body = path.read_text().split('---', 2)
blocks = []
for block in body.strip().split('\\n\\n'):
    number, *verses = block.splitlines()
    assert int(number) == len(blocks) + 1
    blocks.append([number, *[
        re.sub(r'\\.{2,}', '', re.sub(r'"'^'"\\d+\\. ', '', verse))
        for verse in verses
    ]])
for block in blocks:
    for i, verse in enumerate(block[1:], 1):
        for old, new in {
            'hussain': 'Hussain', 'damishq': 'Damishq', 'koofe': 'Koofe',
            'karbala': 'Karbala', 'quraan': 'Quraan', 'sakina': 'Sakina',
            'zahra': 'Zahra', 'akbar mera': 'Akbar mera',
            'Rooz-e-Mehshar Gar Chahiye Nijat': 'rooz-e-mehshar gar chahiye nijat',
            'Dil Mein Basa Le Apne Shabeer Ki Qabar': 'Dil mein basa le apne Shabeer ki qabar',
        }.items():
            verse = verse.replace(old, new)
        block[i] = verse
